tools.name: record_intent
tools.description: Declare what you are about to buy and why, before paying. Returns an intent ID, the mandate check and the expiry. It also returns policy_check and policy_warning: whether the purchase is inside your company's spending rules. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit (cents; 6 decimals for US

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Ask Luca, before you pay, whether this payment is allowed: your registration approved, an open intent that fits, within your mandate. Returns approve or decline with the reasons, sealed. If it says decline, do not pay. policy_warning true means the payment is outside your company's spending policy;

tools.name: record_settlement
tools.description: Report a payment after you make it, on a rail Luca does not read directly (for example an x402 or MPP payment from your own wallet). Call it once the payment has gone through, with the intent_id from record_intent, so Luca matches what was paid to what you declared. Luca seals the payment as a recor

tools.name: report_delivery
tools.description: Report what the merchant actually confirmed (booking confirmation, receipt), using the same field names as the intent's terms. Luca compares them and raises any difference to your owner.

tools.name: cancel_intent
tools.description: Withdraw an intent you will not pay, for example because the payment failed or the purchase was called off. Say why. A payment made under it afterwards is outside consent.

tools.name: get_intent
tools.description: Look up one of your intents by its ID. Use it before paying to confirm the intent is still open, or after paying to confirm the payment matched it. Returns intent_id; status (open: waiting for its payment; matched: a payment settled it; expired: its time ran out; cancelled: you withdrew it); matched

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Check that a Luca record of one of your payments is intact and signed by Luca.

tools.name: my_exceptions
tools.description: List the open items about your own payments that your owner or finance has to look at: a payment outside consent, a mandate breach, a payment with no intent, an intent never settled, a delivery that differs from the terms. Use it after paying, or before a new purchase, to see what is waiting on you.

tools.name: record_sale
tools.description: When your company is the seller: what a payment you received was for and the service period it covers, by the payment's own reference. Luca uses the period to recognize the revenue over it (ASC 606 / IFRS 15).

tools.name: record_usage
tools.description: When your company is the seller of prepaid credits (credits a customer paid for in advance): report what a customer used.
